description: This file implements the WIFIAgent class which provides an interface for WiFi parameter management, including initialization, get/set operations, attribute management, object creation/deletion, and health/session management APIs. It directly interacts with underlying system components via external C functions and includes logic for handling large values, applying settings, and validating parameter operations.

classes.name: WIFIAgent
classes.description: The WIFIAgent class provides methods for managing WiFi parameters, attribute configurations, lifecycle management, health checks, and session control, acting as an interface between higher-level scripts and lower-level system components.
